Laura —

Thanks for the write-up. Quick reads:
- If the scope is clearly cross-functional ownership + mentoring multiple teams, that aligns with L6 (Staff). If it's primarily feature ownership inside a single team, that's L5.
- SARAH's current comp at Nebula (as you noted) is in the $180-200k base range — moving straight to L6 base at our midpoint would be a ~20% uplift. We need to ensure the business case (impact / org gap) is documented.

Proposal:
1) Offer L5 base at $170k with a $35k target bonus + $30k RSU grant (total ~ $235k on-target). Present a clearly defined growth path to L6 at 12 months conditioned on delivery milestones.
2) If Marissa wants a straight L6, have Marissa add 2–3 bullet points in the justification memo (ownership, cross-team scope, revenue impact) and I'll ping Markus for compensation committee approval.

Please prepare both offer variants in the draft PDF and redline the comp spreadsheet with rationale. I'll take the L6 memo to Markus if needed.

Evelyn Hart
VP, Talent & People Operations | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com
